title.narrative: Grants Management contributing to domestic accountability in Tanzania

description.narrative: This activity Grants Management contributing to domestic accountability in Tanzania is a component of Accountability in Tanzania Programme (ACT) reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £30,831,674. It works in the following sector(s): Democratic participation and civil society, Media and free flow of information, Women's rights organisations and movements, and government institutions.
